official.deadline_note: No closing date is published on the scholarship's official page and there is no separate scholarship application to miss. QUT's international scholarships hub states only that 'the on-time application closing date for the upcoming semester is fast approaching'; check the target course page and QUT key dates for the intake you apply for.
official.application_cycle: QUT's international scholarships hub states 'Applications are open for 2025' and invites applicants for the upcoming semester; the dedicated scholarship page (updated 13 August 2026) publishes no cycle year or closing date.
official.status_note: QUT lists the International Merit Scholarship as a current 'future student scholarship' on its official scholarships page, and the international scholarships hub states applications are open with the on-time application closing date for the upcoming semester approaching.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Official wording: 'You'll receive an ongoing scholarship to cover 25% of your tuition fees per semester of study at QUT provided you meet the ongoing academic requirements of the course.' QUT's scholarships hub words the same benefit as covering '25% of your tuition fees for the full duration of your program, provided you meet the minimum academic standards.'

eligibility: Meet the academic entry requirements for the degree program

Meet the minimum English language entry requirements for the degree program; completing a QUT pathway program for the purpose of satisfying QUT English language requirements may make you eligible once you start your degree program

You're not eligible if you receive another QUT academic scholarship

Meet the minimum academic standards for your high school qualification (undergraduate and vertical masters entry), assessed on your best result for qualifications and studies accepted by QUT

Only if requesting a review: a statement on why you believe you have qualified for the scholarship plus supporting documentation, submitted via your agent or by replying to your offer email

Demonstrated academic excellence in your past studies
Your best result for qualifications and studies accepted by QUT is used in determining eligibility
Continued achievement of high standards for the duration of your studies

official.application_route: No separate application - assessed automatically from your QUT course application, with the scholarship offer issued alongside your admissions offer letter.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students; listed by QUT under international citizenship eligibility for future students.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - it is a scholarship for future international undergraduate and postgraduate students only.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Eligible courses across all five faculties: Faculty of Business and Law; Faculty of Creative Industries, Education and Social Justice; Faculty of Engineering; Faculty of Health; Faculty of Science - including double degrees, vertical double degrees and international transfer programs.
official.duration: Ongoing for the full duration of the program, paid as 25% of tuition fees per semester, provided you meet the ongoing academic requirements of the course.
official.description: QUT describes this as 'a high achievement scholarship for future international undergraduate and postgraduate students', awarded to international students who have demonstrated academic excellence in their past studies and who continue to achieve high standards for the duration of their studies.
official.program_type: Academic merit - high achievement scholarship (tuition fee waiver)
official.english_requirement: Meet the minimum English language entry requirements for the degree program; if you complete a QUT pathway program for the purpose of satisfying QUT English language requirements, you may be eligible for this scholarship once you start your degree program. No specific IELTS/TOEFL score is published on the scholarship page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic 25% tuition-fee waiver for international students starting an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at QUT - there is no separate scholarship application, and QUT assesses the qualifications in your course application and tells you the outcome with your offer letter. The reduction applies every semester for as long as you keep meeting your course's ongoing academic requirements, so it is effectively a full-program fee discount rather than a one-off payment. It only touches tuition: the remaining 75% of fees, living costs, health cover, flights and visa expenses stay on you, and the waiver cannot be held alongside another QUT academic scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Academically strong international applicants with a confirmed or planned QUT coursework offer who want a meaningful tuition reduction without preparing a separate scholarship application.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target course sits in an eligible area on the scholarship page - all five faculties, double degrees, vertical double degrees and international transfer programs are listed
Convert your grades to QUT's scale early: postgraduate coursework needs GPA 5.00/7 (completed Australian bachelor degree or higher) or GPA 5.50/7-equivalent for other recognised bachelor degrees
Check your English results meet the degree's minimum entry requirements - a completed QUT pathway program can satisfy this
Verify you are not receiving another QUT academic scholarship, which disqualifies you
Apply before the on-time application closing date for your intake and keep your offer letter and transcripts ready in case you need to request a review
common_rejection_risks: Grades just under the country-specific undergraduate thresholds or the 5.00/5.50 postgraduate GPA cut-offs
Already holding another QUT academic scholarship, which makes you ineligible
Returning to a prior QUT course of study - QUT states these applicants will not be reconsidered
Assuming hardship, medical or disruption circumstances will help - QUT says eligibility is decided solely on the academic record
Letting grades slip after acceptance: the waiver is conditional on the ongoing academic requirements of the course
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 75% of tuition fees each semester, plus living costs, Overseas Student Health Cover, airfares and visa costs - none of these are covered by this scholarship.
document_audit: No scholarship documents are required up front - QUT assesses what you submitted with your course application
Paperwork only exists for a review: a written statement on why you believe you qualified plus supporting documentation, sent through your agent or as a reply to your offer email before you commence
Requesting a review does not restart assessment if you have already commenced study
alerts: There is no scholarship deadline to diarise, but the waiver rides entirely on your course application - miss the intake's on-time closing date and you miss the assessment
The benefit is per semester and conditional: failing to meet the course's ongoing academic requirements ends it
QUT College of Excellence membership is described as a possible additional benefit, not a guaranteed one
The International Talent Scholarship (20% per semester) and QUT College Merit Scholarship are separate QUT awards with different rules - check you are reading the right page
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for an eligible QUT course through the normal international application route; QUT assesses your qualifications automatically and issues the scholarship offer together with your admissions offer letter.
